emergence.summary: Loss-of-function of lysosomal acid beta-glucosidase (GBA1 / glucocerebrosidase) lowers the catabolism of glucosylceramide, so the substrate accumulates in macrophages. The throughput axis is driven DOWN; correction is to restore enzymatic throughput (replace the enzyme / stabilise residual enzyme) or to lower the substrate load upstream.

falsifiers.measurable_by: lysosomal glucocerebrosidase activity and glucosylceramide level in GBA1-deficient macrophages
